hero.headline: A church for three languages.
hero.lede: We have gathered in Monterey Park for fifty years. Grandparents worship in Cantonese, parents in Mandarin, children in English — in the same building, on the same morning.

sections.label: This Sunday
sections.heading: Three congregations, one morning.
sections.intro: Each congregation streams on its own channel. Live links update automatically from YouTube — nobody edits this weekly.
sections.englishBlurb: Mostly the children and grandchildren of the founding families. Sunday school runs at the same hour.
sections.cantoneseBlurb: Our founding congregation. Preaching in Cantonese, tea afterwards in the courtyard.
sections.mandarinBlurb: Our newest congregation, with traditional-character subtitles. Sunday school at the same hour.
sections.footerNote: Watching from home? Open the player for your congregation. Every service is posted to the sermon archive within a day or two.

sections.name: Rev. Chan
sections.label: A note from our pastor
sections.heading: You are welcome here, whichever language you pray in.
sections.body: We began in 1976 with a handful of families. Today three congregations share this building, and many of our members are the children and grandchildren of the people who started it.
sections.bodyZh: 若您初次來訪，請放心前來，隨意入座。我們不會請您站起來自我介紹。門口的同工會為您指引兒童教室與後方停車場。

sections.heading: Children & families
sections.body: Children are welcome in every service. Sunday school runs during the 11:00 hour in English and the 11:30 hour in Mandarin, and a staffed nursery is open all morning for the youngest.
sections.note: Every volunteer who works with children has completed a background check and our safeguarding training.

groups.title: Nursery · 0–3
groups.body: Open 9:15 AM – 12:45 PM, hallway by the courtyard.

groups.title: Sunday school · 4–11
groups.body: During the 11:00 and 11:30 services, two rooms upstairs.

groups.title: Youth · 12–18
groups.body: Friday evenings in the Fellowship Hall, with supper.
